annotations.text: Three paragraphs, no ledger, no signature, no name. The background is one clause in the first sentence, and the owner said one passing mention is the whole of it. Every sentence is his to keep, reword or strike.

Option B names no individual and promises no response time, so it sits inside the current policy rather than reversing the 2026-08-05 retirement in H-12; it still takes the owner's nod. Nothing on the code side moves until the H-66 row is Chosen. Option A leaves every support line as it is today; the rest of the canvas stands either way.

Five plain sentences, every one a shipped fact, the price interpolated from marketing.ts. The one new control is the link. The hero's budget (one primary, one secondary) is untouched. The last sentence moves with the support decision in H-66.
